cells.gaps: The latest figure, 77.7 per cent of people aged 10 and over, stated in November 2026 with no survey or year named, is below 80 per cent.
cells.note: An official's figure of 77.7 per cent of people aged 10 and over, stated at a national forum in November 2026, replaces the ITU's 2024 estimate of 70 per cent. It is past half and below 80 per cent.
